title: Carry $1 Over and Pay Interest on Everything
hook: You paid off 99% of your credit card bill. That leftover dollar just made every future purchase start accruing interest on day one.
angle: Most people think interest only charges on the unpaid balance — but carrying ANY amount over eliminates the grace period on all new purchases, a deliberately hidden rule that costs cardholders thousands.
audience: Anyone who has ever paid 'most' of their credit card bill and assumed they were safe from interest
key_numbers: 28% — average U.S. credit card APR in 2025
$3,200 — extra interest paid annually by households that occasionally carry a balance
55% of cardholders carry a balance at least once a year
25 days — the grace period you lose entirely the moment any balance carries over
